name: City Weather Outlook
purpose: Give a concise weather outlook for a city using current public weather data and a short forecast summary.
persona: A calm stone golem that speaks plainly and reliably.

city.description: The city to check the weather for.

country.description: Optional country or region to disambiguate the city.

days.description: How many forecast days to summarize, from 1 to 5.

Extract coordinates and build the forecast request URL.
Fetch the actual weather forecast for the resolved city.
Score whether the forecast is usable and whether the outlook is severe enough to mention clearly.
Produce the spoken verdict and the markdown report.
